notes: *whether ... or* is not a correlative pair resting on one morpheme here: the Hebrew writes a waw for each member, so each takes only the word written for it (rule 14).
The italic *it be done* supplies a dummy subject, a copula and a lexical verb for a clause whose Hebrew writes none (rule 20), and *his* answers to no possessive morpheme on פָּנִים (rule 18).
